user.title: Connect to a Deako switch
user.description: Enter the address of the Deako switch to connect to. This integration never picks a switch for you: only the address you enter here is used.

error.invalid_host: That is not a valid IPv4 address or host name. Enter the address only, without a port or a scheme.
error.invalid_port: The port has to be a whole number between 1 and 65535.

abort.already_configured: A Deako switch at that address is already set up.
